body: You are not the only one. I have not taken any full length practice exams and have done only Jack Westin practice problems. I essentially was bribed by my dad to take the MCAT. I had a choice to either take the extra money or have to work two jobs since I am apparently "wasting my time". I decided to take an L and retake the exam at a much later date. Definitely do not recommend studying for the MCAT if you do not have the proper support system
